roadHazards.title: Other information
roadHazards.details:
Milling work on the Ring Road through Borgarnes—stretching from Borgarbraut to the bridge over Borgarfjörður—is scheduled for the evenings of Sunday, August 16, and Monday, August 17.
The road will be closed during the work, and a detour via Borgarfjarðarbraut will be signposted.

The work is expected to take place between 21:00 and 07:00 on both evenings.

roadHazards.title: Road repairs
